name: Bibliography
description: Represents the list of sources available attached to the document (in the current list) or the list of sources available in the application (in the master list).
remarks: Biblographies are composed of sources. Also see the Source object and the Sources collection. For more information, see Working with Bibliographies.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Bibliography object.

properties.name: Sources
properties.description: Returns a Sources collection that represents all the sources contained in a bibliography. Read-only.

properties.name: BibliographyStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that represents the name of the active style to use for a bibliography. Read/write.

methods.name: GenerateUniqueTag
methods.description: Generates a unique identification tag for a bibliography source and returns a String that represents the tag.
